global_summary: This video is a documentary-style compilation showcasing the origins and evolution of parkour, focusing on its pioneers like David Belle. It blends archival footage from early 2000s French TV broadcasts (TF1/TFI) with dynamic parkour sequences across urban environments. The content includes athletic stunts (rooftop jumps, building scaling, acrobatics), behind-the-scenes interviews with practitioners and family members (e.g., Monique Belle), and historical context—presenting parkour as both a physical discipline and a cultural phenomenon.
